name: What preparation is needed before Hometelligent installs my new shower glass?
description: Before installation, ensure all tile work is complete and cured, the shower base is level, and the work area is clear. We confirm readiness beforehand.

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before Hometelligent installs my new shower glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before Hometelligent installs your new shower glass, it's crucial to ensure that all surrounding tile work is complete and fully cured, typically 24-48 hours after grouting. The shower base or curb must also be level and prepared to support the glass enclosure. Having a clean and clear work area allows our installers to proceed efficiently and accurately. We will confirm these readiness points during our pre-installation check to avoid delays.
